limitations: Unspecified text dimensions use Pillow metrics from the preserved MasterFont TTF at the inherited FDF font size; Warcraft native font rasterization, glyph spacing, baseline and line-box rules have not been measured.
SetPoint offsets and explicit dimensions are evaluated directly without layout adjustments; text measurement differences propagate through dependent anchors.
Only explicitly declared panel controls are emitted; inherited control internals and popup MENU frames are not separate visible records.
Dynamic dropdown selections and runtime-populated item lists are not present in FDF and remain empty; no resolution/provider choices are invented.
Null color means no FontColor on the frame/template chain; it is not an inferred native default.
